d: We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarter in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners.
About The Foodics Recruitment Open Day Event💡
Ready to take your career to the next level? Join us for the Foodics Recruitment Open Day in Al Madinah on 24–25 November, from 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM!
This exciting event offers a unique opportunity to meet our hiring team in a 15-minute walk-in interview for the Relationship Management Specialist role.
Learn more about the role, explore Foodics culture, and discover how you can be part of our journey.

The Relationship Management Specialist is responsible for managing a portfolio of customers, ensuring successful renewals, proactive issue resolution, and ongoing value realization. The role goes beyond renewals to act as a trusted customer success partner, with direct ownership of churn prevention and ARR retention.

Located in Manama's prestigious Seef District, Barceló Hotel & Residences Bahrain is a contemporary 4-star property combining elegance, luxury, and operational excellence. The hotel features 195 stylish rooms and suites, multiple dining venues, wellness and fitness facilities, rooftop experiences, and business-focused services, making it an ideal destination for both leisure and corporate travelers.

The Hotel Manager at Barceló Hotel & Residences Bahrain is responsible for overseeing all aspects of hotel operations, ensuring the highest standards of guest satisfaction, financial performance, and team development. This role requires a dynamic leader with a strong focus on operational excellence and brand integrity.
Lead, manage, and motivate all hotel departments to ensure efficient and effective operations, including front office, housekeeping, food and beverage, maintenance, and sales.
Develop and implement strategic plans to achieve financial targets, including revenue growth, cost control, and profitability.
Maintain and enhance guest satisfaction through proactive service delivery, prompt resolution of guest issues, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure compliance with all local regulations, company policies, and brand standards across all operational areas.
Oversee human resources functions, including recruitment, training, performance management, and employee relations, fostering a positive and productive work environment.
Manage hotel budgets, financial forecasts, and capital expenditure planning.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and guest feedback to identify opportunities for improvement and innovation.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including owners, suppliers, and local community representatives.
Implement and maintain robust health, safety, and security protocols for guests and employees.
Represent the hotel at industry events and community functions as required.
Bachelor's degree in Hotel Management, Business Administration, or a related field; Master's degree preferred.
Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive leadership experience in hotel operations, with at least 3-5 years as a General Manager or Hotel Manager in a reputable 4-star or 5-star hotel.
Demonstrated strong financial acumen with a proven track record of achieving budgetary goals and driving profitability.
Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills with the ability to inspire and motivate a diverse team.
Extensive knowledge of all hotel operating departments, including front office, F&B, housekeeping, and maintenance.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on strategic planning and execution.
Proficiency in hotel management software (e.g., Opera, Fidelio) and Microsoft Office Suite.
Fluent in English; proficiency in Arabic or other languages is a significant advantage.
Proven ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong understanding of local market dynamics and cultural sensitivities in Bahrain.
